title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Muraqqa Leaf. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Muraqqa Leaf
options.lineage: Ottoman album leaf: dark muraqqa border, one miniature, an inscription cartouche
options.thesis: You are inside an open album. The plate is a jewel on lacquer; the script sits on a bone label facing it.
options.viewport: Full-bleed album. Left: the scene image in a ruled window, large. Right: bone cartouche of scene text. Scene index in the dark margin. No sidebar.
options.risk: Can slide into museum-vitrine Ottoman if the album becomes a frame around a card instead of the room you read in.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.lineage: Wide-margin scholarly setting with a vermilion centre rail of keys
options.thesis: A history edition open under a lamp: plate and script as twin columns around a keyed rail of scenes.
options.viewport: A small type block in a wide margin. Left column the plate, right the script, a vermilion rail of scene keys between. Image-off lets the script take the measure.
options.risk: Reads as philology, not telling — the meddah becomes a footnote apparatus.
options.case: Wins reading-tool clarity and the image-off widen; loses audience identification to the album (scholar, not storyteller).

options.label: Swiss Poster Spread
options.thesis: Each scene is one poster on a modular grid: a photographic fragment and flush-left script, one signal bar for where you are.
options.viewport: A visible grid. Image as a large photographic fragment left; script set ragged-right on the module; a single red bar marks the scene.
options.risk: Geometry starves the plate — images must stay strong when present.
options.case: Fuses cleanly as a reading tool; weaker identification (concert posters are not this writer's home) and may shrink the image.

options.label: Select Rail
options.lineage: Film cutting bench, perforated select rail, tape flags
options.thesis: Scenes hang as punched frames on a grain-orange rail; the leaf you stopped on wears a folded flag.
options.viewport: A perforated rail of scene frames across the top; the current plate fills a punched white window; script sits in a second window. Flag on the active frame.
options.risk: Becomes an editing suite — the storyboard tool they already refused.
options.case: Fuses poorly because the bench is an operate surface; sequential frames are clear, the room is wrong.

canonCard.label: Kindle-kind reader
canonCard.thesis: A serious reading tool: type first, optional image pane, executed at full craft with no costume.
canonCard.viewport: Comfortable measure of scene text; image beside it when on, gone when off; quiet scene list. What this category ships.
canonCard.risk: Correct and forgettable — a reader anyone could have shipped.
